points.description: States that linked lists are passed by reference (e.g. passing a pointer/reference to the head node so the function works on the original list).
points.partial_credit: Part marks if vague or partly wrong, e.g. mentions passing the head pointer or address without saying by reference, or says 'by reference' with a minor error in explanation.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that linked lists are passed by reference, in any wording (e.g. 'pass the head pointer/address'). Part marks for a vague or half-correct statement, or the right idea mixed with a minor error. No marks for 'by value' or for answers about linked lists that never say how they are passed.
